FORM.SUMMARY: Add the teams and competitions that will be part of this season. You can can then configure them in the Season Admin > Configuration tab.

HELPERS.ROUNDS: Add the number of rounds that will be played in this competition. For example, if there are 10 teams and 2 rounds, each team will play 18 matches (9 home and 9 away).
HELPERS.TEAMS: Add the teams that will be part of this competition. You can also set starting points for each team.
HELPERS.SPLIT: Select this if your table splits. You will see a line in the table after the position you select
HELPERS.PRIORITY: The priority determines the order that the competitions will be displayed in the season

ADD_SEASON.ERROR: There was an error adding the season. Please try again.

EDIT_SEASON.ERROR: There was an error updating the season. Please try again.

DELETE_SEASON.ERROR: There was an error deleting the season. Please try again.

UPDATE_COMP_CONFIG.ERROR: There was an error updating the configuration. Please try again.
